meta.title: Credit/Debit Note Approval Workflow: refused for a user without the Finance Controller role
gaps: Access the Credit/Debit Note Approval Workflow and configure credit/debit notes above a threshold to require approval
Sign in as a user without the Finance Controller role and verify the action is refused or unavailable
Sign in as a Finance Controller in the same tenant and verify the action is available
Verify or report whether tenant RBAC deliberately grants the action to additional roles
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Access the Credit/Debit Note Approval Workflow and configure credit/debit notes above a threshold to require approval; Sign in as a user without the Finance Controller role and verify the action is refused or unavailable; Sign in as a Finance Controller in the same tenant and verify the action is available; Verify or report whether tenant RBAC deliberately grants the action to additional roles

args.need: sign in as both the non-Finance Controller user and the Finance Controller in the same Enterprise tenant, run the Credit/Debit Note Approval Workflow for credit/debit notes above an approval threshold, and compare whether the action is refused or unavailable for the first user and available for the Finance Controller

steps.note: The required workflow, role-specific sessions, threshold configuration, and RBAC comparison are not expressible by any catalog step.
Confirm the session remains free of a visible application error after the tester completes or skips the missing workflow checks.
